description: ZeniFlow is a personal finance app for tracking money across wallets. Through ChatGPT a user can log income and expenses in plain language, add a whole list of them at once, correct or delete an entry they got wrong, and move money between their own wallets as a proper double-entry transfer. It also answers questions about where the money went: totals by category, spending trends, monthly and yearly reports, how each budget is tracking, upcoming subscriptions, progress toward saving goals, and who owes what in the user's debt book. Wallets are created in the ZeniFlow app rather than here, so the user always sets the opening balance themselves.
